cases.geometry_input: Checksummed finished native-coordinate STEP exports: new unified module with unchanged drawer components.

limitations: Closed rigid assembled pose only. Positive exploded-view offsets are illustrative, not collision-certified paths. Module mouth webs and box runner-channel sheets are removed; printing meshes retain them. Lock, pinion, screws, and runner stoppers are omitted. Geometry cases are exactly those listed; definition coverage does not imply native solid collision coverage for other configurations. No physical print-fit qualification.
